core_philosophy.price_movement: Price hamesha POI aur Liquidity ke darmiyan move karti hai. POI par ho to Liquidity dhoondti hai, Liquidity par ho to POI dhoondti hai.
core_philosophy.nearest_rule: Nearest liquidity ko price pehle hunt karti hai (chor-police analogy)
core_philosophy.big_players: Big players retail ka SL hunt karke apne orders fill karte hain, phir strong move dete hain

bias.rule: Bias sirf Higher Time Frame (Monthly → Weekly → Daily) se find karo
bias.detail: Monthly se start, phir Weekly, phir Daily. Teeno ka direction dekh kar final bias decide karo. Lower TF (4H, 1H, 30M, 15M) par bias find nahi karna.
bias.conflict_rule: Conflict ho to bada TF jeete (Monthly > Weekly > Daily)
bias.monthly_open_rule: Monthly chart at least 2 weeks ya har month ek baar zaroor open karo

condition_1.name: POI → Liquidity
condition_1.detail: Price POI se nikalti hai aur Liquidity hunt karti hai. Highest win probability.

poi_types.rule: POI mark karna zaroori hai price ke aas-paas. POI aur Liquidity dono ko equal importance do.

liquidity.definition: Liquidity = Retail traders ke Stop Losses (SL)
liquidity.why_needed: TP find karna, reversal trades lena, trapping se bachna, entry lena

type_3_chart_pattern.rule: Bias ki direction mein patterns WORK, bias ke against = TRAP

type_5_consolidation.rule: Zone ke UPAR aur NEECHE dono side

type_7_lrl_hrl.lrl: Low Resistance Liquidity — bina POI, price FAST move
type_7_lrl_hrl.hrl: High Resistance Liquidity — POI ke saath, price SLOW/consolidate
type_7_lrl_hrl.liquidity_void: Middle FVGs = LRL, first+last FVG = HRL

type_8_external_internal.external: HH ke UPAR / HL ke NEECHE
type_8_external_internal.internal: Leg ke andar (small swings, FVG, OB)

trends.sideways: HH/LL break hota hai par wapas aa jata hai → NO TRADE

external_vs_internal.external: Main overall structure (HH/HL ya LH/LL) — bias determine karta hai
external_vs_internal.internal: External ke andar chhote swings — HH/HL count nahi hote

formation.uptrend: High ke LEFT side wala swing break
formation.downtrend: Low ke LEFT side wala swing break

idm.rule: IDM ke baad hi HH/LL confirm hota hai

structure_mapping.start_point: Uptrend = lowest se start, Downtrend = highest se start

fvg.multiple_rule: First ya last FVG use karo, beech wale skip
fvg.power_rule: FVG size ≠ power — chhota bada barabar

bpr.definition: Balanced Price Range — 2 opposing FVGs ka overlap

gap_imbalance.market_rule: Mostly Indian market, forex mein ignore

breakaway_gap.definition: FVG ka unfilled portion after partial fill

gaps.bias_rule: Bias ke against gaps = trap, skip

definition.bullish: Bullish move ki LAST SELLING CANDLE (sabse zyada low lagaya)
definition.bearish: Bearish move ki LAST BUYING CANDLE (sabse zyada high lagaya)

order_block.color_rule: Color matter nahi — extreme high/low dekho

validity.rule: OB tabhi valid hai jab uske saath FVG ho
cases: OB candle + FVG same candle = valid
OB candle, no FVG, next candle FVG = valid (next candle OB)
OB candle, no FVG, no next candle FVG = invalid

location.swing_extension: Agar price zone mein na aaye aur naya extreme bana de → swing extend karo, phir re-mark karo

order_block.multiple_rule: First (after IDM) ya last (extreme) use karo — beech wale skip
order_block.ob_fvg_combined: OB + FVG = combined zone (entry poore zone par)

mitigation.bullish: Pullback se pehle wale swing HIGH ki extreme HIGH candle (market ne high ke upar body close kiya ho)
mitigation.bearish: Pullback se pehle wale swing LOW ki extreme LOW candle (market ne low ke neeche body close kiya ho)

refinement.bullish: Upper wick only (agar FVG se overlap ho)
refinement.bearish: Lower wick only (agar FVG se overlap ho)

breaker.bullish: Pehle low sweep + phir high break (body close) → extreme high candle
breaker.bearish: Pehle high sweep + phir low break (body close) → extreme low candle
breaker.power: Mitigation se zyada strong (dono side sweep)

tgl.rule: Sab ka kaam ek hi hai — trend join/continue karwana

mitigation_breaker.level_fail: Koi bhi level tab fail hota hai jab us ke andar candle body close kare — sirf wick se nahi

three_candle_swing.rule: Process matter karta hai, candle count nahi
steps: Candle 2: Displacement (FVG/OB creation ke saath strong move)
Candle 3: Last POI of displacement leg retest
three_candle_swing.rule_additional: 2 candles mein bhi ho sakta hai, 10 mein bhi. Process sequence matter karta hai.

displacement.definition: Price ka fast, strong move jismein FVG ya OB bane
displacement.why: Big players ke bade orders se price fast move karti hai
displacement.how_to_identify: POI tap ke baad achanak fast move + FVG/OB creation
displacement.if_not: Agar price slow/sideways rahe, koi FVG/OB na bane → displacement nahi hui → trade nahi
displacement.bot_logic: IF candle creates FVG/OB in direction → displacement = TRUE

mss.definition: Market Structure Shift = last swing high/low ka break

entry_module.lrl_left_side: Aggressive entry (displacement only, no MSS wait)
entry_module.structure_mapping_vs_entry: HTF structure ≠ LTF entry structure (donon alag)

risk_management.sl_rule: SL = Entry POI ke neeche (buy) / upar (sell) + buffer
risk_management.rr_rule: Sirf 1:3 RR wali entry (author ka original rule nahi — user decision)
risk_management.backtest: Har pair par strategy test karo

asian_strategy: Pehla valid POI (jo tap na hua ho) mark karo
Agar valid POI na ho → high/low liquidity mark karo
London/NY mein entry tab lo jab: pehle session ki liquidity sweep + MSS + last POI tap
session_strategy.timezone: UTC-4 (New York) chart aur killzone indicators par set karo

ote.definition: Optimal Trade Entry — swing low se swing high par 0.5-0.6 fib level
ote.use: Reversal trades ke liye entry tool (indicator nahi)

mirror_concept.rule: Trend-side POIs (FVG/OB/Mitigation) pullback ke raste mein mirror ka kaam karte hain — price ko wapas trend direction mein dhakelte hain
mirror_concept.detail: Agar pullback ke raste mein trend-side POI ho → wapas trend mein aayegi. Agar clean range ho → price next liquidity tak ja sakti hai (danger).

idm.rule: IDM ke baad hi HH/LL confirm hota hai
idm.sweep_rule: Body close zaroori nahi, sweep bhi valid
idm.vs_mss: IDM = fake break (trap), MSS = valid structure break

do_rules: Sirf Main Bias (POI → Liquidity) trade karo
Nearest liquidity pehle hunt hoti hai
Entry sirf 3-candle swing confirm hone par LTF par
Displacement ke baad hi entry lo
Bias ke against trade mat lo
bot_quick_rules: BIAS: Monthly → Weekly → Daily (conflict → bada TF)
POI priority: Breaker > OB+Sweep > OB+IDM > Strong Mitigation > Volume Imb > BPR > FVG
ENTRY: HTF POI tap → LTF MSS → LTF displacement → LTF last POI retest
MSS = last swing break (LTF par sweep bhi OK)
Displacement = FVG + OB creation ke saath fast move
SL = LTF POI ± buffer. TP = HTF nearest liquidity
